name: ccscammers-bets
description: Monorepo for the ccscammers-bets platform: React web client, NestJS API, RavenDB storage.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ccscammers/shared && npm run build -w @ccscammers/api && npm run build -w @ccscammers/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
